listings.address: 18978 SW ARROWWOOD AVE Lake Oswego, OR 97035
listings.remarks: New River Grove Elementary has a peaceful street called Arrowwood. This home has been well cared for many years and the lush exterior shows it. Enjoy the updated deck and Hardscaping as well as nice gardening in the front of the home with lots of sun. Inside with open floor plan has original hardwood floors and remodeled kitchen. The island provides an open entertaining area that leads to the upper deck which is good for year round BBQ's as it is partially covered. Appliances are newer stainless steel w/ custom lighting to set the mood. Both levels do have a gas fireplace and bathroom. If you like a sauna including heated floors in the bathroom then you're in luck here. Plenty of storage in the cabinetry downstairs as it is currently a recording and mixing area. Lake Oswego has recently completed the swim and community center on the same side of town. Enjoy the Lake Oswego swim park, bike trails including lots of walking options. Other amenities include Lake Grove dining, Bridgeport village as both have shopping to your hearts content.

Elegance meets modern comfort in this beautifully updated estate, featuring many exceptional and valuable upgrades and improvements inside and out. Over $750,000 in improvements. The main level offers a spacious living and dining area, a dedicated den, and a chef’s kitchen outfitted with premium appliances - gas range and Miele induction cooktop, double wall oven, Belko refrigerator, dishwasher, and two beverage refrigerators. Imagine entertaining in this dream kitchen outfitted with 3 ovens, gas cooking and an induction cooktop. The inviting great room showcases a fireplace, custom built-ins, and double doors leading to an expansive stamped concrete patio, complete with retractable awning, creating an ideal setting for entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find four bedrooms, including one with a built-in Murphy bed, along with an exquisite primary suite featuring double door entry, a remodeled spa-inspired bath, an oversized shower, a stately soaker tub, and a luxurious walk-in closet outfitted with every amenity you could dream of. This home perfectly blends timeless craftsmanship with top-tier modern amenities: Anderson windows and doors, Graber shutters, Bryant high-efficiency furnace and A/C, tankless hot water heater, whole-home water filtration system, Hans Grohe emergency shut-off, backup generator, two gas fireplaces, encapsulated crawlspace, sump pump, presidential composite roof, remodeled baths, updated lighting and hardware, and recent upgrades including an air purifier and gas meter. Outdoors, enjoy a newer fence, professionally maintained landscaping, and the added comfort of retractable awnings to maximize your enjoyment of the outdoor spaces. Enjoy the Westlake Summer Concerts just across the street. Every inch of this impeccable home reflects thoughtful upgrades, ensuring not only elegance and style but also lasting peace of mind. This is luxury living at its finest - truly a one-of-a-kind opportunity.

$1,500,000 | 5 Bed | 3 Full + 2 Half Baths | 4,209 SF | 4-Car parking. This is not your typical Lake Oswego home. Set on a sprawling .85-acre private lot in the heart of the coveted Southshore neighborhood, this property is more akin to your own secluded park than a traditional residence. The expansive backyard, complete with a sport court and covered patio, creates a serene retreat for year-round recreation and entertaining — all while being just minutes from top-rated schools and the shores of Oswego Lake.The thoughtful floor plan is designed for modern living, featuring a sought-after owner's suite on the main floor. This private retreat offers exceptional convenience with a full bathroom and walk-in closet, plus a separate half-bath that features a second walk-in closet and a tranquil infrared cedar sauna. The main level flows effortlessly, with rich hardwoods connecting the living and dining rooms, while the updated kitchen shines with a new gas stovetop, stainless steel appliances, and new pendant lighting. What truly sets this home apart is the second living suite upstairs, offering a fully independent space ideal for extended family, frequent guests, or anyone seeking private quarters within the home. Three additional bedrooms provide ample room, with one perfectly suited for a home office or den. The home's versatile spaces continue with a workout studio featuring cork floors and a skylight, plus a finished dance studio above the garage — offering endless possibilities for creative and active lifestyles. With over $300,000 invested in recent improvements, peace of mind comes standard. This extensive list includes a new architectural roof, new upstairs windows, a new furnace and A/C, an on-demand water heater, and an EV charger. The exterior and interior were repainted in 2021, and all bathrooms have been tastefully updated with new tile floors, quartz countertops, and custom glass showers.

OPEN HOUSE Saturday, Aug 15th 12-2pm. Discover the joys of urban living in this classic family home. Perfect for professionals, families, and outdoor enthusiasts who want both the vibrancy of city living and the tranquility of nature. This charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom house offers an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living room to the kitchen and family room, enhanced with hardwood floors and large windows with a panoramic view of nature, creating a warm and tranquil atmosphere. And two gas fireplaces help make the spaces cozy. A welcoming open kitchen and family room layout is designed for entertaining. The family room extends out onto a deck for grilling and includes a patio area for dining and entertaining or just to enjoy the outdoors. Your furry friends will be safe in the private, fenced yard featuring a special area with artificial turf designed just for them. The kitchen features granite countertops, cherry wood cabinets, a gas range with warming rack, and an abundance of cabinets for storage space. New, plush wall-to-wall carpeting has been installed in both the primary and guest bedroom (office). The home's exterior has a new front stairway leading to the front door and ample guest parking is available with a large driveway. For access to the house without using the front stairs, there is an entry gate in the fence on the south side of the house leading directly to the patio, deck and family room. For peace of mind, a natural gas-powered generator stays with the house in case of particularly stormy weather. Within miles of trails, OHSU, Council Crest park, downtown Portland, the Pearl District, and top medical centers, the location couldn't be more convenient.

GRACIOUS LIVING IN FOREST HEIGHTS: Welcome to the pinnacle of custom luxury that redefines bespoke Forest Heights living! This 4,200 square foot home captures the imagination at every turn, from the European inspired exterior profile to the graceful arches that greet you at the front door and usher you in to explore more. Settle into the inviting living room with soaring ceilings and oversized fireplace or make your way across beautiful hardwood floors to the purely magical sunroom with territorial views in every season. Find yourself lost in the custom chef’s kitchen with custom canary wood cabinetry and Wolf/Sub-Zero appliances. Fall in love with the generous primary suite on the main floor with its adjoining sitting room, deck, and fireplace. Nothing has been spared in design or implementation on this one. Details at every turn like solid, Canary wood doors, custom designer window coverings, one-off light fixtures, and luxury textiles and textures make for a refined living experience. And behind it all is the peace of mind that can only come with fastidious caretaking. Lenox HVAC, whole home Kohler generator, EV charger, and constant attention on maintenance needs, this home is move in ready. Make this tour the top of your search and the beginning of a life well lived in Forest Heights.

Set high above the surrounding neighborhood, this contemporary retreat offers more than 5,400 square feet of thoughtfully designed living, where expansive interiors meet peaceful tree-top views. Walls of south-facing glass and soaring vaulted ceilings fill the home with natural light throughout the day, while rich hardwood floors and multiple fireplaces bring warmth and balance to the scale of the space.Designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining, the kitchen flows naturally to generous outdoor spaces, creating an easy connection between indoors and out. Whether hosting friends or enjoying a quiet morning above the trees, the setting feels remarkably private.Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a true escape, complete with its own private balcony overlooking the surrounding canopy. The finished daylight lower level offers exceptional flexibility, featuring separate living quarters with an additional kitchen and living area—well suited for multigenerational living, extended guests, a dedicated work-from-home setup, or potential income-producing possibilities.Positioned on a private corner lot with an oversized three-car garage, the home enjoys the advantage of Washington County taxes while remaining just minutes from parks, shopping, dining, and downtown Portland.

Step into modern Bethany living—bright, inviting, and thoughtfully designed for everyday comfort. Welcome home to 14896 NW Minda Street, ideally located in the desirable Ridgeline at Bethany community, where convenience, style, and natural surroundings come together. Bursting with natural light and clean contemporary finishes, this home features an open-concept main level with a seamless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living spaces—perfect for both entertaining and daily living. The kitchen offers an island layout, ample cabinetry, and modern finishes designed for functionality and ease.Upstairs, the spacious primary suite provides a relaxing retreat with a spa-like bathroom and a generous walk-in closet, while additional bedrooms and a conveniently located laundry room create a practical and efficient layout. Thoughtful upgrades include high-end window treatments throughout, adding both style and privacy. Step outside to enjoy a peaceful setting as the home backs to green space, offering a sense of openness and connection to nature rarely found in newer communities. Located within walking distance to the elementary school, and just minutes from parks, trails, shopping, and dining, this home offers exceptional livability in one of Portland’s most sought-after suburban neighborhoods. Boasting modern design, a prime Bethany location, and a serene green space setting—this is Northwest living at its finest. Come experience it for yourself.

The Nedonna Farmhouse with Basement, greenspace views. The main floor offers great room concept with defined informal dining area. Kitchen features blue cabinets with black accents, KitchenAid appliances. Second level provides 4 bedrooms including the primary with double sinks and walk in closet. Basement provides additional living space/bonus room, bedroom and full bathroom. Designer appointed features included in price. Flat, landscaped, fully fenced yard. Just minutes from parks, trails, and Bethany Lake, with access to Pirate Park, Rock Creek Trail, and nearby farms offering berry picking and pumpkin patches. Stroll to Bethany Village Centre for shopping, dining, and seasonal events like summer concerts and holiday markets. Nearby local favorites include the charming Piccolo Mondo Toy Store and family-focused Play Street Museum. Forest Park, Oregon Zoo, and top Portland attractions are a short drive away. Home includes Designer appointed finishes, Please contact sales for details. AC, EV pre-wire and covered deck included. Photos of same plan, different location, Exterior photo of actual house. Buyers Agent must be present

Luxury meets nature in this nearly new McCormick Craftsman, completed in late 2022 and ideally positioned on one of the community's most desirable homesites. Backing to protected green space on both the rear and side of the property, this exceptional setting offers a rare sense of privacy, peaceful forest views, and the feeling of having no immediate neighbors beyond your own backyard. The covered outdoor living area and expansive great room are perfectly oriented to capture the tranquil surroundings through walls of glass, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle.Inside, a dramatic two-story entry, soaring 10-foot ceilings, and impeccable craftsmanship set the tone for this beautifully upgraded home. The gourmet chef's kitchen is appointed with premium appliances and designer finishes, while the expanded primary suite features dual walk-in closets and a luxurious spa-inspired bath. A main-level office/den or a 6th bedroom and a versatile finished lower level provide ideal accommodations for guests and multigenerational living. Built with today's most desirable amenities, including zoned HVAC, a tankless water heater, this residence combines modern luxury with exceptional livability. Just minutes from top-rated schools, parks, trails, and Bethany Village, this is a rare opportunity to own a better-than-new home in an unmatched natural setting.

Discover the perfect blend of luxury and comfort in this exquisite, warm, and inviting home. Gourmet kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances, new in-wall oven, and gas cooktop, opens to a walk-out deck, ideal for entertaining. Beautiful wood floors, large windows, gas fireplace. Main level features a primary ensuite with a built-in fireplace, walk-in shower, double sinks, and a large closet. Also on main floor is an inspiringly bright office with double doors & built-ins. Below, you'll find three bedrooms, a family room, two full baths, and a hobby room, all with access to a walk-out deck. Additional features include two laundry rooms, a three-car garage, a new roof, and a quiet cul-de-sac backing to a tree-lined backyard with a view. This one’s a gem! But wait, there’s more! An incredible lower level awaits with wood floors, tall ceilings, another bedroom, and a separate large room complete with a private entrance, full bath, and walk-out deck. This light and bright space invites you to bring all your bonus room needs and hobbies (think dance studio, art, music, homeschooling, or a home business). For this home the possibilities are endless. Make this dream home yours today!

Experience modern luxury in this rare and highly sought-after ‘Rogue’ Craftsman-style home built in 2023 by Pac. Lifestyle Homes. Over $140K in construction and post-closing upgrades elevate the living experience well beyond builder standards. Luxury appliances, upgraded flooring, designer window treatments, custom closet organizers, and a gas fireplace with a custom stone-and-shiplap surround ensure every detail feels refined. The inviting 1st floor flows past the main-level bedroom/office and full bathroom, into a stunning great room with soaring 18-foot ceilings, tall windows, and a seamless open layout that unites the designer kitchen, dining area, and sun-filled living room, perfectly blending comfort and style. The upper level features 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including an exceptional primary suite with a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and spacious closet space, along with a convenient laundry room with a utility sink, while expansive windows throughout the level offer stunning views of the beautiful community. Unlike similar homes, which are often limited to smaller garage spaces, this property offers a 3-car tandem garage, fully finished with epoxy floors—ideal for the most meticulous hobbyist or craftsman. Outdoors, the covered patio extends the living space, perfect for year-round entertaining and enjoying the professionally designed backyard landscape. The yard also includes a 120 sq/ft. Pro-Series Tough Shed, perfectly matched to the exterior of the home, that provides exceptional storage and utility. The home has been meticulously maintained, including a recent deep cleaning of carpets, windows, and exterior soft wash. Located in River Terrace, a vibrant community ideally situated between Beaverton, Tigard, and Oregon wine country. With upscale finishes, high-efficiency systems, a reputable builder, and a location that balances city access with natural charm, this home delivers extraordinary value and stands out as truly “better than new".
